caps.text: Hi. It is late, so nothing big is needed. What would feel kind to start with? just keep me company, or empty my head, or one small start?
I keep putting off replying to my landlord about the renewal.
Hey. Pick one sentence to send. Draft “Thanks for the notice; I’ll review and reply by tomorrow.” Then send it. Ready?
Can you break this down into an ultra-micro step?
Wait, stop. Actually, can we just make it smaller?
Sure. Type “Thanks, will reply.” and hit send.
Hola, ahora necesito empezar mi declaración de impuestos, pero no sé por dónde empezar.
Hola. Busca el formulario 1040 en el sitio del IRS. ¿Quieres abrirlo?
